Discover and frame.title: Frame the outcome
Discover and frame.applies: Every project or change; lightweight for clear low-risk work.
Discover and frame.evidence: Goal, surface, accountable owner, requested stop, and known authority.

Discover and frame.title: Validate the problem
Discover and frame.applies: When the user, problem, or expected value is not established.
Discover and frame.evidence: Stakeholder evidence, unresolved assumptions, and validated problem or an explicit open decision.

Discover and frame.title: Agree scope and acceptance
Discover and frame.applies: Every change; a scoped small correction may substantiate this briefly.
Discover and frame.evidence: Accepted scope, exclusions, testable outcomes and any explicit limits.

Design and plan.title: Inspect existing systems and constraints
Design and plan.applies: When existing behavior, integration, or failure modes affect the work.
Design and plan.evidence: Source or observation-backed baseline and material unknowns.

Design and plan.title: Resolve architecture and interfaces
Design and plan.applies: Material changes to behavior, interfaces, data, or cross-team ownership.
Design and plan.evidence: Agreed boundaries, trade-offs and relevant design decisions.

Design and plan.title: Design user flows and measurement
Design and plan.applies: When changing a user journey or how success will be measured.
Design and plan.evidence: User flow, accessibility needs, measurement and learning plan.

Design and plan.title: Resolve material risks and decision rights
Design and plan.applies: Sensitive data, security, AI authority or other material risk.
Design and plan.evidence: Scope-specific approved controls or explicitly named unresolved decisions.

Design and plan.title: Define the behavior contract
Design and plan.applies: For work whose agreed outcomes need implementation-ready behavior and tests.
Design and plan.evidence: Versioned spec, acceptance cases and error paths tied to scope.

Design and plan.title: Plan changes and verification
Design and plan.applies: Every change; proportionate to scope and risk.
Design and plan.evidence: Work breakdown, independent slices, verification plan and dependencies.

Build and instrument.title: Prepare acceptance fixtures
Build and instrument.applies: When the change needs fixtures and the relevant acceptance contract is stable.
Build and instrument.evidence: Representative positive, negative, boundary, and failure fixtures tied to the agreed contract.

Build and instrument.title: Plan observable signals
Build and instrument.applies: When the behavior or operating risks require new evidence in production.
Build and instrument.evidence: Agreed signals, interpretation and owners for detecting success or regression.

Build and instrument.title: Build software
Build and instrument.evidence: Candidate revision and scoped changes with local evidence.

Build and instrument.title: Build hardware or device integrations
Build and instrument.applies: For hardware, embedded work, or device interfaces.
Build and instrument.evidence: Bench evidence, integration boundaries and safe recovery path where relevant.

Build and instrument.title: Build data, ML, and agent components
Build and instrument.applies: For data or AI work, with appropriate data and authority boundaries.
Build and instrument.evidence: Versioned pipeline or agent changes, inputs, evaluation baseline and local checks.

Build and instrument.title: Instrument and document changed behavior
Build and instrument.applies: As needed when behavior, indicators, interfaces, or operating procedures change.
Build and instrument.evidence: Inspectable signals and current reader-facing docs bound to the changed surface.

Verify and review.title: Verify the actual candidate
Verify and review.applies: Every change; run evidence proportionate to the selected delivery path.
Verify and review.evidence: Results against acceptance criteria at a specific revision, with clear blind spots.

Verify and review.title: Review the actual candidate
Verify and review.applies: Where the project requires independent review or acceptance.
Verify and review.evidence: Review verdict and required approvals for the same candidate revision.

Release and transition.title: Prove readiness and recovery
Release and transition.applies: When transitioning a live service, model, data set, or operating procedure.
Release and transition.evidence: Applicable capacity, migration, recovery, rollout and rollback proof.

Release and transition.title: Release or roll out under authority
Release and transition.applies: Only when the requested stop and explicit authority include the action.
Release and transition.evidence: Authorized plan, actual deployed revision and post-change checks.

Operate and learn.title: Operate and diagnose a live system
Operate and learn.applies: When a service is live or the task is operational; no assumed release prerequisite.
Operate and learn.evidence: Service evidence, owner, impact and recovery/response state.

Operate and learn.title: Close the loop and reopen affected decisions
Operate and learn.applies: After a release observation window, incident, or product experiment.
Operate and learn.evidence: Sourced outcome, lessons, and only accepted follow-up decisions.
